class.name: PerformanceStudio_CAMJob
class.brief_description: Represents a Job within a Track in a CAM.

method.name: set_dependencies
method.description: Marks this job as depending on the specified jobs. When viewing the custom activity map in Streamline, selecting a job will visualise its dependencies.

method.name: stop
method.description: Register that the job has completed at this point in time.
